decisions.reason: The stacking tray is a core extension of the firm's display business and its announced 3D cardboard direction, and management has already reaffirmed it once, so persistence and the need to justify that decision favor keeping it.

The online customer portal is distant from the core business, but it supports the announced deeper customer collaboration and information-security direction, and it was launched only recently, so any weak uptake can still be blamed on start-up effects.
The packaging display won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, a strong public endorsement that both validates the investment and commits the firm visibly to the product.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display sits close to the core offer, has its own dedicated web page as a visible commitment, and has had too little time for disappointing results to count against it.
The small counter display is a near-core product with a dedicated page, so its visibility and its fit with the firm's display-only focus favor persisting with it.
The large freestanding information display fits the broader 3D cardboard strategy and was presented publicly on its own page only last year, so management would keep it.
